patch.evidenceNote: Odoo 19 provider documentation establishes External JSON-2 at /json/2/<model>/<method>, bearer API-key authentication, database-specific /doc discovery, ordinary Odoo access-right/record-rule/field enforcement, dedicated bot-user guidance, a maximum three-month API-key lifetime, optional X-Odoo-Database routing, and one SQL transaction per JSON-2 call. Legacy XML-RPC/JSON-RPC common/object services are deprecated in Odoo 19 with JSON-2 as replacement. No sandbox or tenant was authenticated and no live read was performed, so this is specification evidence only.

securityEvidenceBlockers: JSON-2 uses HTTP POST for both reads and potentially mutating model methods. Before authentication evidence advances, prove executor-enforced exact model+method read allowlists; HTTP verb, successful authentication and a public ORM method are never write/read authority by themselves.

JSON-2 inherits the dedicated user's Odoo access rights, record rules and field access. Prove a bot identity with only the required database/company/model/field visibility and demonstrate that create, write, unlink, action/control and credential-management methods are denied.

Actual models, fields and methods are database-specific and may change with installed apps, custom modules, custom fields and Odoo Online intermediate versions. Discover the authorised database /doc and reviewed metadata, fingerprint schemas and fail closed on breaking drift instead of assuming stock model names or fields.

Each JSON-2 call runs in its own SQL transaction. Multi-model or multi-call reads must preserve their observation window and cannot be represented as one atomic source snapshot; prefer single-call methods such as search_read and reconcile partial or high-skew reads.
API keys cannot last more than three months. Prove secure rotation and revocation without enabling programmatic key generation/revocation in the steady-state WFM data-plane identity.
On-premises/private Odoo deployments require an authorised customer-edge HTTPS route. WFM must not scan, bridge or directly expose customer private networks.

Legacy XML-RPC/JSON-RPC common/object services are deprecated in Odoo 19 and scheduled for removal. They remain migration-only and must not become a new-integration dependency where JSON-2 is available.
